description: This file defines the login page component for a Next.js application, implementing a sign-in form with validation, error handling, and redirection upon successful authentication. It integrates with Supabase for authentication and uses React hooks for state management.

methods.name: LoginPage
methods.description: React functional component that renders the login form, handles user input, validation, submission, and redirects if already authenticated.

methods.name: onSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission: validates, attempts sign-in via Supabase, handles errors, and redirects on success.
